name: fleetline-marketplace
description: Marketplace for fleetline, a pluggable statusline plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: fleetline
plugins.description: A hardened statusline for Claude Code — protected against the git-config RCE and ANSI-injection bugs most statuslines ship with. Every segment is independently repositionable with your own separator (not just theme presets), plus a fleet-view renderer for multi-agent sessions. Bash + jq only, Linux/WSL verified.
